links.comparator_used: Off-the-shelf pre-trained ECG foundation model fine-tuned elsewhere and applied to ICU data as-is, versus targeted fine-tuning on curated public datasets with or without weakly labelled in-house ICU data
links.outcome: F1 for sinus rhythm and atrial fibrillation classification on ICU continuous monitoring data
links.effect: Off-the-shelf: F1 0.68 (SR) and 0.52 (AF). After fine-tuning on consistent public datasets: F1 0.91 (SR) and 0.82 (AF). Adding weakly labelled ICU data further improved recall.
links.tradeoff: Adding weakly labelled in-house ICU data improved recall at some cost to precision.
links.quote: Fine-tuning on consistent public datasets achieved robust performance (F1 = 0.91 for SR, 0.82 for AF), while adding weakly labelled ICU data further improved recall at some cost to precision.

design_hint: local fine-tuning and validation on local ICU data before deployment
